# N-Forma website preview

A public, browser-rendered version of the N-Forma website for design and content review.

- [Home](https://ulalus.github.io/n-forma-site-preview/)
- [Services](https://ulalus.github.io/n-forma-site-preview/services.html)
- [Cases](https://ulalus.github.io/n-forma-site-preview/cases.html)
- [Technologies](https://ulalus.github.io/n-forma-site-preview/technologies.html)
- [Knowledge base](https://ulalus.github.io/n-forma-site-preview/knowledge.html)
- [Company](https://ulalus.github.io/n-forma-site-preview/company.html)
- [Contacts](https://ulalus.github.io/n-forma-site-preview/contacts.html)

The site is in Russian. Its content and graphic design are available directly in the rendered pages. Links to detailed services, forms, case studies, and policies lead to the existing N-Forma website.
